purpose: Per-source, per-access-layer record of exactly which limits the governing evidence establishes, which it does not, and the provenance of each established value. Nothing here is inferred, estimated or fabricated.

governing_requirement.requirement_verbatim: Execute exactly one governed fresh full-route LiTS pass, six bounded physical witnesses and retained WVS replay/comparison. Account separately for file hash passes, path-level opens and their measurement basis, metadata reads, header-prefix reads, decoder calls, selected-column/full reads, byte counts and retries. A full Route-B pass is not a claim of one OS-level file open.
governing_requirement.acceptance_verbatim: Freeze expected budgets and instrumentation before launch; retain measured counts. WVS and excluded-source fresh opens remain zero under this scope.
governing_requirement.acceptance_shortfall: Four mandatory accounts have no budget anywhere to freeze.

mandatory_separate_accounts.account: file hash passes (full SHA-256 over the file)

value_grade_legend.E: exact value established in governing evidence, with provenance
value_grade_legend.H0: hard zero; a single non-zero count is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance
value_grade_legend.F1: floor of 1 established, NO ceiling established
value_grade_legend.—: no value exists anywhere in the governing evidence

ACC-10_retries.provenance: artifact 07 .SRC02.max_retry_budget; global frozen maximum ZERO retries across all eight sources

ACC-04_metadata_reads.note: artifact 07 states NO expected_metadata_reads for SRC26. The operation class BOUNDED_HEADER_PREFIX_PLUS_READER_METADATA implies a reader-metadata read occurs, but no count is stated anywhere. This is recorded as no value, NOT as an established zero. See obligation R9-OBL-07.

ACC-05_header_prefix.caveat: A bounded byte quantity. It does not bound the number of header-prefix reads. See obligation R9-OBL-06.

ACC-09_byte_counts.law: Geometry divergence between raw header 174 and decoded dictionary width 332 is expected, NOT equality-required, and must never be collapsed.
ACC-09_byte_counts.distinction_preserved: 174 is the raw nominal case size; 176 is the bounded header-prefix byte quantity. They are DIFFERENT quantities and are not conflated.

operation_level_law.retry_law_verbatim: Exactly ONE governed fresh pass. A second pass is not a retry; it is a separate run requiring new HQ-bound authority.

ACC-01_existence_access.provenance: artifact 07 hardened_note_on_the_SRC27_single_pass 'at minimum: one existence/access check'

ACC-02_hash_pass.provenance: artifact 07 hardened_note 'at minimum: ... one full SHA-256 hash pass'

ACC-04_metadata_reads.provenance: artifact 07 hardened_note 'at minimum: ... one metadata read'

ACC-07_selected_reads.note: SRC27 has no expected_selected_reads. Its read is a full-route read. Mapping it into a selected-read slot would be a fabrication.

ACC-08_full_reads.provenance: artifact 07 hardened_note 'at minimum: ... one full compatibility read'
ACC-08_full_reads.note: No expected_full_reads exists for SRC27. The hardened note establishes a FLOOR, not an exact count.

separate_accounts_law.accounting_warning_verbatim: One governed Route-B pass is NOT one OS-level file open. Existence/access check, full hash pass, metadata read and full compatibility read are SEPARATE accounts.
separate_accounts_law.hardened_note_verbatim: The frozen 'exactly one governed fresh full Route-B pass' is a WORKLOAD constraint, not an access constraint. It does NOT license assuming one file open. The run will require at minimum: one existence/access check, one full SHA-256 hash pass, one metadata read, and one full compatibility read. Each is a separate account under O1-C07.
separate_accounts_law.misreading_law_verbatim: Misreading this as one open would be an accounting failure and is expressly forbidden by Omega-1.
separate_accounts_law.floor_is_not_a_ceiling: The hardened note says 'at minimum'. A floor is not an enforceable ceiling. No governing artifact supplies a maximum for any of these four layers.

RES_1.statement: The Stata extended-missing dual-shape branch is NOT source-free round-trip testable in pyreadstat 1.3.6.
RES_1.run_requirement: Record the exact reader_token and stata_token shapes the real decode produces, under the bound reader lane, as an explicit warrant-time observation. This is NOT a source-free PASS.
RES_1.accounting_effect: An additional warrant-time OBSERVATION obligation. It does not create an additional access-layer count.

SRC35.c4b_scope_reason_verbatim: Seven future fresh-read sources only; SRC35 is excluded because it is a retained comparator.
SRC35.why_outside_the_target_set: SRC35 is a retained comparator replayed from retained material only. It generates no fresh-source access-layer accounts. Including it in a per-access-layer fresh-access binding would misrepresent a retained comparator as an access target and would weaken the accounting.
SRC35.retry_law_verbatim: No fresh access at all. Replay uses retained material only.
SRC35.read_path_verbatim: NO FRESH LANE. Retained comparator; zero fresh raw reads.
SRC35.explicitly_not_unconstrained: SRC35 carries a zero-fresh-read law, a hard-zero global open budget, a retained-only reader lane and a zero retry budget. It is constrained, not unconstrained.

c4b_seven_slot_bind_test.repair_specification: Restore a per-source source_access_accounting block for all seven sources with C4B's seven exact-count slots and their basis/config/reason qualifiers, populated or bound to the frozen expectations in artifact 07.

retries.reason_source: per-source retry_law plus global frozen maximum ZERO retries across all eight sources

c4b_seven_slot_bind_test.conclusion: The R9 repair as specified by both independent reviews CANNOT be completed as specified. Completing it would require inventing at least three counts.

cross_check_against_R2_field_presence_ma.my_independent_census: identical presence and absence sets for all six fields
cross_check_against_R2_field_presence_ma.note: R2 addressed the WARRANT's missing per-source block and assumed artifact 07 could supply the values. My finding is a further step: artifact 07 cannot supply them for three of the seven slots.

stop_trigger_gap.statement: None of artifact 07's ten O1-C08 stop triggers tests an access-layer COUNT against a bound. They govern identity, locator, authority, ordinals, runtime, reader lane, oracle custody, physical witness, named consumer and dependency/currentness.
stop_trigger_gap.why_not_patched: Adding a count-exceedance stop would require a bound that does not exist for four accounts. Inventing thresholds to fill it would be a fabrication.

enforcement_semantics.hard_zeros_verbatim: These are hard zeros. A single non-zero count in any of them is a STOP condition, not a reportable variance.
enforcement_semantics.enforcement_caveat: The governing artifacts label the six-source counters 'expected_*'. No governing artifact states that exceeding an expected_* figure is itself a STOP condition. The enforceable ceiling for those layers therefore rests on max_retry_budget = 0 plus the immediate-stop retry law, NOT on an explicit maximum.
measurement_basis_fields: at what point in the run

no_values_fabricated.statement: Every value in this record was read from a governing artifact at a pinned commit. No count was inferred from an operation class, derived from a retry budget, promoted from a floor to a ceiling, or taken from a prior lane's estimate.

r9_closure_effect.conclusion: R9 remains the sole warrant-instrument technical blocker. This record delimits it precisely rather than closing it.
